messages.subject: Locator/ClickId in Server
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to build a shinyApp where point coordinates from a reactivePlot were displayed only after users have pushed an actionButton (see my simplified code below)

I saw the clickId parameter for plotOutput but I would like to put the locator/clickId in the server because of the "observe"

I looked for solutions on internet but I did not manage to do it without calling for a new plot.

Does anyone have any ideas?

Thank you very much in advance !!

CHa

runApp(list(
  ui = bootstrapPage(
    uiOutput("sample1"),
    plotOutput("sample2", clickId = "oi")
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {
    output$sample1 = renderUI({
      actionButton("Click","go")
    })
    output$sample2 = renderPlot({
      plot(1,1)
    })
    observe({
      if(is.null(input$Click)){}
      else{
        if(input$Click >0){
          output$sample2 = renderPlot({
            plot(1,1)
          }, clickId = "oi")
         
        }
       
      }
    })
   
  }
))
